name: Runpod Pods (dedicated H100 / H200 / A100 GPU instances)
price_basis: per GPU-hour, Community Cloud Pods (a dedicated instance, per-second billing available). H100 SXM $3.49; H100 PCIe $2.89; H100 NVL $3.19; H200 $4.59; B200 $6.79; B300 $7.89; A100 80GB $1.59; L40S $1.09; L40 $0.82; A40 $0.49; L4 $0.49; RTX 3090 $0.50; RTX 4090 $0.74; RTX Pro 6000 $2.09. Page states 'Updated September 27, 2026'; fetched 2026-10-03.
notes: THE BEST-PRICED H100 PER HOUR IN THE SLICE, $3.49 for SXM and $2.89 for PCIe, and the only provider here offering both the H100 SXM and the PCIe part at separately published prices so you can pick by form factor rather than by guesswork. Also the broadest catalogue: the same page lists B300, B200, RTX Pro 6000, H100 NVL, A40, A6000, 3090, 4090, 5090 and L40S, which makes it the one-stop shop if you need a consumer or workstation GPU for a small model. Three caveats that matter. (1) 'Community Cloud' is hosted hardware from third parties with a separate 'Secure Cloud' column at different rates - if your data matters, the number you want is the Secure Cloud one and the page does not price both in the extracted table. (2) Availability is genuinely in-stock, which is the whole reason Runpod is the fallback when AWS p5 is allocation-only. (3) The Clusters product is NOT the same price: H100 SXM and L40S and B200 clusters are 'Contact sales', and only H200 ($4.31) and A100 ($1.79) are published. Reserved Clusters are contact-sales for every GPU, with 1/3/6/12-month terms and no published discount. Storage runs $0.05-0.14/GB/month. No sales call and no contract for the Pod rate - a credit card is enough.
